properties.description: It's Game of the Year meets King of the Hill as four of Earth's best friends – Griffin McElroy, Justin McElroy, Chris Plante, and Russ Frushtick – rank and review their favorite video games. Because shouldn't the world's best friends pick the world's best games?
properties.short_description: Four friends rank and review their favorite video games in a fun and engaging format.

short_descriptions.value: Vier Freunde bewerten und besprechen ihre Lieblingsvideospiele auf unterhaltsame und fesselnde Weise.
Cuatro amigos clasifican y reseñan sus videojuegos favoritos de forma divertida y amena.
Quatre amis classent et critiquent leurs jeux vidéo préférés de manière amusante et engageante.
Four friends rank and review their favorite video games in a fun and engaging format.

properties.description: The Giant Bomb discusses the latest video game news and new releases, answers listener questions, and sometimes gets wildly off-topic in this weekly podcast. Featuring Jan Ochoa, Jeff Grubb, and Jeff Bakalar.
properties.short_description: The Giant Bomb discusses video game news, new releases, and listener questions in a weekly podcast.

short_descriptions.value: Giant Bomb bespricht Videospielnachrichten, Neuerscheinungen und Hörerfragen in einem wöchentlichen Podcast.
Giant Bomb analiza noticias de videojuegos, nuevos lanzamientos y preguntas de oyentes en un podcast semanal.
Giant Bomb discute les actualités des jeux vidéo, les nouvelles sorties et les questions des auditeurs dans un podcast hebdomadaire.
The Giant Bomb discusses video game news, new releases, and listener questions in a weekly podcast.

properties.description: The original classic gaming podcast continues its endless quest to explore the history of video games, one game at a time. Join hosts Jeremy Parish and Bob Mackey each week as they team up with a host of expert guests to chronicle the creations that have paved the way for today's hits. From forgotten black-and-white arcade machines to modern-day remakes, Retronauts spans more than four decades of vintage gaming greatness!
properties.short_description: Exploring the history of video games, one game at a time, with expert guests and hosts Jeremy Parish and Bob Mackey.

short_descriptions.value: Erkundung der Videospielgeschichte, ein Spiel nach dem anderen, mit Experten und den Moderatoren Jeremy Parish und Bob Mackey.
Explorando la historia de los videojuegos, un juego a la vez, con expertos y los anfitriones Jeremy Parish y Bob Mackey.
Explorer l'histoire des jeux vidéo, un jeu à la fois, avec des experts et les animateurs Jeremy Parish et Bob Mackey.
Exploring the history of video games, one game at a time, with expert guests and hosts Jeremy Parish and Bob Mackey.

properties.description: Every Friday, Polygon's Simone de Rochefort, Allegra Frank, and Chelsea Stark talk about what's new and weird in video games. Expect goofs, the occasional soft drink-related tirade, and a lot of laughs. Produced by Polygon and the Vox Media Podcast Network.
properties.short_description: Polygon's team discusses the latest and quirkiest in video games with humor and lively banter.

short_descriptions.value: Das Polygon-Team bespricht die neuesten und skurrilsten Videospiele mit Humor und lebhafter Unterhaltung.
El equipo de Polygon comenta lo último y más curioso en videojuegos con humor y animada charla.
L'équipe de Polygon discute des dernières nouveautés et bizarreries des jeux vidéo avec humour et échanges animés.
Polygon's team discusses the latest and quirkiest in video games with humor and lively banter.
